content.css: @keyframes fade-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } @keyframes pop-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.85); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } } @keyframes slide-up { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(35px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .corner-tag { position: absolute; right: 24px; top: 24px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #F59E0B; background: rgba(245,158,11,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.2); letter-spacing: 1px; } .step-card { position: absolute; left: 60px; right: 60px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 28px 36px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.25); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(245,158,11,0.1); } .step1 { top: 120px; } .step2 { top: 250px; } .step-card > span:first-child { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F59E0B, #EF4444); color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 900; flex-shrink: 0; } .step-card > span:last-child { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 900; color: #111827; letter-spacing: 2px; }
